# Clean fixture: a deterministic evaluator shape. Clock values arrive as
# explicit inputs (D-P3); datetime TYPES are fine, wall-clock CALLS are not.
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def within_window(observed_at: datetime, deadline: datetime) -> bool:
    return observed_at <= deadline


def deadline_for(event_at: datetime, days: int) -> datetime:
    return event_at + timedelta(days=days)
